files.README.md:
# mongorust-mongodb-from-mongosh

Data access layer generated by [DB2CRUD](https://github.com/RaulEstevezA/DB2CRUD) for a database that already exists: plain entities, repositories and services with the MongoDB driver, in asynchronous Rust. It does not create or migrate the database, and it depends on no web framework.

## Settings

- Database: mongodb.
- Entities: written for the tables the input had no type for.
- Services: take and return DTOs; updates take a Patch per field: Absent, or set to a value that may be None; errors are `Result<T, DomainError>`.
- Transactions: every repository write is committed at once.
- Lists: lists return pages by offset and limit.

## Layout

```text
src/database.rs          the connection of DATABASE_URL
src/bson_values.rs       values of documents, and what changed in one
src/unit_of_work.rs      the repositories of every table, and the transactions
src/errors.rs            DomainError: NotFound, Conflict, ValidationFailed, Database; no HTTP codes
src/entities/            one entity per collection
src/repositories/        the repositories of each table
src/services/            one service per table
tests/data/              repositories against a database, services on the in-memory repositories
crud-contract.json       what was written, for CRUD2Controller
```

## Running the tests

```bash
TEST_DATABASE_URL="mongodb://localhost:27017/app" cargo test   # a real, disposable database: it is emptied
```

Look for `TODO` in the code: each one marks a decision the input did not settle.

//! What the service of products takes and returns.

/// The values of a new Product. Fields left None take the database's default; the service says which ones are required.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, PartialEq)]
pub struct ProductCreate {
    pub sku: Option<String>,
    pub price: Option<rust_decimal::Decimal>,
    pub stock: Option<f64>,
    pub weight: Option<f64>,
    pub big: Option<i64>,
    pub created: Option<chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>>,
    pub reference: Option<uuid::Uuid>,
    pub picture: Option<Vec<u8>>,
    pub key: Option<uuid::Uuid>,
    pub pattern: Option<mongodb::bson::Bson>,
    pub patterns: Option<Vec<mongodb::bson::Bson>>,
    pub text: Option<String>,
    pub parts: Option<Vec<crate::entities::product::ProductPart>>,
    pub low: Option<i64>,
}

/// A Product as services return it.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct ProductRead {
    pub id: String,
    pub sku: Option<String>,
    pub price: Option<rust_decimal::Decimal>,
    pub stock: Option<f64>,
    pub weight: Option<f64>,
    pub big: Option<i64>,
    pub created: Option<chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>>,
    pub reference: Option<uuid::Uuid>,
    pub picture: Option<Vec<u8>>,
    pub key: Option<uuid::Uuid>,
    pub pattern: Option<mongodb::bson::Bson>,
    pub patterns: Option<Vec<mongodb::bson::Bson>>,
    pub text: Option<String>,
    pub parts: Option<Vec<crate::entities::product::ProductPart>>,
    pub low: Option<i64>,
}

/// The values of a Product that change: fields left Absent keep their value; Patch::Set(None) empties one.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, PartialEq)]
pub struct ProductUpdate {
    pub sku: crate::common::Patch<Option<String>>,
    pub price: crate::common::Patch<Option<rust_decimal::Decimal>>,
    pub stock: crate::common::Patch<Option<f64>>,
    pub weight: crate::common::Patch<Option<f64>>,
    pub big: crate::common::Patch<Option<i64>>,
    pub created: crate::common::Patch<Option<chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>>>,
    pub reference: crate::common::Patch<Option<uuid::Uuid>>,
    pub picture: crate::common::Patch<Option<Vec<u8>>>,
    pub key: crate::common::Patch<Option<uuid::Uuid>>,
    pub pattern: crate::common::Patch<Option<mongodb::bson::Bson>>,
    pub patterns: crate::common::Patch<Option<Vec<mongodb::bson::Bson>>>,
    pub text: crate::common::Patch<Option<String>>,
    pub parts: crate::common::Patch<Option<Vec<crate::entities::product::ProductPart>>>,
    pub low: crate::common::Patch<Option<i64>>,
}
